skills.name: Align unlike denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator for unlike fraction parts and convert fractions to equivalent forms with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract same-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fraction parts with a common denominator by subtracting numerators, keeping the denominator, and simplifying the fractional result when needed.

skills.name: Manage mixed and whole numbers
skills.definition: Represent whole numbers and mixed numbers as whole-plus-fraction quantities, subtract whole parts, and combine or report the resulting whole and fraction parts.

skills.name: Borrow across whole and fraction parts
skills.definition: When the fractional subtraction is negative, regroup one or more wholes as denominator-over-denominator fractions and adjust the whole part accordingly.
